capabilities.name: Film commissions
capabilities.can: We make music videos, short films and campaigns with captured and generated images, edited and graded in-house.
capabilities.needs: A brief and a conversation about scope.
capabilities.limits: Scope, timing and price are agreed per project.
capabilities.evidence: Five films released on YouTube since August 2026.

capabilities.name: Continuity pilot
capabilities.can: For small hybrid teams getting revisions from several tools or people: one agreed scene or sequence, an approved reference record, person-reviewed findings with frames and timecodes, a correction list, and one review of the returned revision.
capabilities.needs: The reel, or the scenes in question, and any references you have.
capabilities.limits: The automated check is not reliable enough to run alone, so a person reviews every flag. Offered as a scoped pilot.
capabilities.evidence: The check has run on written cases and one real scene (see Research).

capabilities.name: V AI prototype, 25 steps
capabilities.can: Runs inside Claude. Drafts every step for your own film, from brief to release, and exports a workbook with one sheet per step.
capabilities.needs: A Claude account; each run uses the visitor's own Claude usage.
capabilities.limits: Drafts only. Work is saved in that browser's local storage: it survives a refresh or closing the tab, but not a different browser or device, and clearing site data deletes it. No shared projects, approvals or versions yet. Each draft needs checking by a person.
capabilities.evidence: Recorded run, 13 November 2026: a one-minute test film planned in 14 steps in about six minutes.

capabilities.name: Script breakdown
capabilities.can: Reads a whole screenplay, scene by scene, into a stripboard with cast, props, wardrobe, effects and what continuity must hold, plus a production assessment and a CSV.
capabilities.needs: The script as PDF, Word, Final Draft or text.
capabilities.limits: Not yet compared against a breakdown done by a first assistant director, so its accuracy is unmeasured.
capabilities.evidence: Recorded run, 13 November 2026: 190 of 190 scenes of a 203-page screenplay read in about two and a half minutes, timed in the browser from sending the script to the finished stripboard, on Claude through the claude.ai artifact (the platform does not report the exact model version). Reading every scene is not the same as getting every requirement right.

capabilities.name: Continuity check
capabilities.can: Compares a new shot, described or as still frames, with the film's record, and lists possible breaks with a severity and a question for a person.
capabilities.needs: The film's record and the shot to check.
capabilities.limits: Sees still frames, not motion. On its first real scene it raised false alarms. Not reliable on footage yet.
capabilities.evidence: First real scene, 11 November 2026: 22 false alarms, then 8 after two fixes (see Research).

capabilities.name: Saved projects, approvals, versions, teams
capabilities.can: One saved record of the film that every step reads and writes, with approvals, versions and history.

capabilities.name: Open and local model deployments
capabilities.can: The same workflows on open models running on a client's own machines.
capabilities.limits: In testing. No local model has passed our exam yet.
capabilities.evidence: Exam, 11 November 2026: two untrained local models scored 16 of 37.

capabilities.name: Learn AI with Videogrammer, one to one
capabilities.can: Live sessions, one to one or for your group, booked when you need them: the latest AI tools for film and creative work, and how to put them to work in your job and your films.
capabilities.needs: Who is learning, what you want to be able to do, and when.
capabilities.limits: Booked on request. Topics, length and fee agreed before each booking. No certificate.

capabilities.name: AI Film School, 48-week programme
capabilities.can: A programme built around six films each learner makes, from a silent point-of-view film to a crewed thesis film.
capabilities.limits: Written in full. Not open for enrolment; no cohort taught yet; not accredited. Dates and fees not announced.

capabilities.name: V AI in school mode
capabilities.can: Asks for the learner's attempt first, critiques their real work and records their authorship.
